master: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: RepNote Android workouts header, landscape 3:1 illustration, transparent background. Input image is the EDIT TARGET and a conceptual reference for a barbell only; replace the simplistic flat icon style completely. Create an expressive, premium hand-painted editorial sports still life: a weight-training barbell at a lively slight diagonal, beside a small open training journal and casually folded fabric towel, all balanced as one composition. Rich opaque gouache brushwork, dry-brush grain within the painted forms, confident dark forest-green ink contours with small imperfect edges, layered mint/sage/ivory shapes, subtle warm ochre accent under 5%, sophisticated drawn illustration not childish clipart, no 3D render and no photography. Palette forest #365F48, deep #153B2A, mint #BCECC8, sage #D5E8D3, warm ivory #F5F1E4 with small cyan #A0CFD4. All major silhouettes should remain readable on both very light and charcoal-green app surfaces: pale painted rim details next to dark edges. No large background disk, no floating decorative bubbles; the objects and energetic short paint strokes should carry the art. Wide composition filling about 80% of frame width and 75% height, 8% transparent safety margins, clear silhouette at mobile card size. Real transparent alpha, no white rectangle, no paper sheet background, no painted UI. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand or watermark. Keep the subject as exercise equipment and journal; no people. Single illustration, not a sheet of variants. This establishes the style for seven matching app assets.
